program.title: BSc in Chemistry
uncertain: total_required_credits (113.0) is the sum of the required_credits of all groups. The program has a mandatory International Research Enrichment (IRE) Track plus three mutually exclusive Tracks/Options (Biomolecular Chemistry Track, Core Chemistry Track + Core Elective, and the Options: Environmental and Analytical / Materials / Pure Chemistry). The sum double-counts shared courses (e.g. CHEM 2410/3420/3555 appear in multiple tracks/options; CHEM 4689/4691 appear in multiple option electives). A realistic total is the core (pre-req 6 + required 26 + capstone 3 + MATH 3 = 38) plus a chosen Track/Option (≈8-18) plus electives (4-12) plus IRE (+3).
Several blocks allow alternative course choices with credit ranges (MATH 3-4, capstone 3-6, Core Elective 4-7), so actual credits may differ from the lower-bound calculation.
The PDF notes CHEM 2410 and CHEM 3420 will become 4 credits each from 2027-28; the 2026-27 printed values (3 each) are used.
The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 CHEM (4Y) (2026-27 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2026-27 intake curriculum.
